method.name: independent_source_evidence_90d
method.description: Coming Soon membership is a 90-day Pacific-local window over four independent evidence facts: AMC Coming Soon catalog membership, Seattle-area AMC theater bookings, TMDB US theatrical releases, and published Reel Seattle showtimes. A film with any local screening on or before the current-availability cutoff is excluded. Otherwise a local future screening yields confirmed_local, AMC catalog membership with an in-window catalog release date yields amc_announced, and TMDB-only evidence yields tmdb_only which is retained but not user-visible.
